cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll find your keys. Stop lifting the sofa; they've made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the cushion down. I'll do the apologising if you'd rather.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologise, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring you tea while we wait. No checking; tell the keys we trust them to come out.
